commands:
set -eu
WT="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/unified-ux-20261104-v1"
OUT="$WT/frontend/test-results"
for size in 390 1440; do
 IMG=$(find "$OUT" -type f -name "unified-ux-$size.png" -print -quit)
 if [ -z "$IMG" ]; then echo "NO_SCREENSHOT_$size"; continue; fi
 TMP="/tmp/photomap-ux-visual-$size.jpg"
 sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 34 -Z 390 "$IMG" --out "$TMP" >/dev/null
 printf 'UX_SAMPLE_%s ' "$size"
 base64 -i "$TMP" | tr -d '\n'
 printf '\n'
done
